# TU Delft presentation template

This is a template for a presentation following the [TU Delft corporate design](https://www.tudelft.nl/en/tu-delft-corporate-design) using Typst polylux.
This is an unofficial template, as the TU Delft was not involved in its development.
It used the font family [Roboto Slab](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto+Slab) and [Arial](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arial) or alternatively the Typst default font [Libertinus Serif](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Libertinus).

The template is made by the same authors as the [TU Delft presentation template found on Overleaf](https://www.overleaf.com/edu/tudelft#templates).
The repository of the developers is https://gitlab.com/novanext

[The template itself](docs/presentation.pdf) gives a more thorough overview of the functionality
